regime_interpretation: Q1 2023 represents a compound scarcity architecture where elevated price risk was linked to broad system stress rather than a single isolated driver.

regime_interpretation: October–November 2024 marks a late-year transition regime where upper-tail stress began to reappear after a quiet first half of the year.
paper_use: Use as a transition case showing that 2024 stress did not emerge in Q1 like 2023, but began to return later in the year.

regime_interpretation: December 2024 represents the main physical scarcity regime of 2024, with upper-tail events linked to tighter physical system conditions.
paper_use: Use as the main 2024 stress benchmark. This case supports the argument that 2024 scarcity was late-year and physically driven, unlike the broader Q1 2023 stress regime.
